test_vectors.coverage: All six value kinds, empty containers and strings, complete root spans, surrounding whitespace, strict/query validation flags, and out-of-range accessors.
Root, array, object, and descendant terminals share one traversal; multiple slots retain identical decoded string references.
Nested containers count as one array element; first, last, absent, and u32::MAX indices; present null differs from missing.
Key/index type mismatches and paths through scalars, empty arrays, and empty objects produce missing slots.
Escaped ASCII, composed and decomposed Unicode, empty keys, NUL, surrogate pairs, numeric text keys, and case sensitivity.
Raw and decoded references match the canonical event stream; decoded key arena prefixes, Unicode, control escapes, empty strings, owned input, and cloned output lifetimes.
Permitted duplicate decoded keys preserve earlier complete selections while later members fill previously missing descendant slots.
Object and array selector parents share a target; input order determines each slot's first complete value independently.
Query preserves the original payload owner and malformed unconsumed suffix, waits for complete containers, and rejects malformed selected values; strict mode propagates suffix errors.
Zero-slot queries accept unconsumed empty or malformed input with a false validation flag; strict mode validates; zero payload limits remain enforced.
Missing selections require complete validation in both modes, including trailing content and malformed unselected subtrees.

Empty and truncated documents, malformed delimiters, literals and numbers, invalid escapes, lone surrogates, invalid UTF-8, control bytes, duplicate keys, and trailing content preserve exact parser errors.
Inclusive payload, depth, array item, object field, string byte, number digit, and decoded arena limits, including zero boundaries.
1,024 nested arrays and selector edges with a terminal at every level verify complete ancestor spans without recursive traversal.
65,536 slots on one terminal, identical results, final valid slot, and first out-of-range slot in both modes.
Minimum container spans, u32::MAX exclusive end, overflow, reversed delimiters, and exact local error source and offset.
Deterministic Vec capacity overflow maps to BudgetExhausted without a large allocation, preserving storage and the absolute error offset.
Invalid graph dimensions, non-advancing and out-of-range targets, invalid terminal slots, remaining-slot underflow, and capture idempotence.
Repeated roots, object values without keys, array counter overflow, and pending unmatched keys.
